name: Animated Album Art
description: Discovers cover-motion.mp4/.mov sidecars in album folders and serves them as animated album artwork.

versions.changelog: Generate smaller H.264 playback copies in Jellyfin's cache without changing original artwork. Add bounded background conversion, cache limits and a preparation task. Preserve authenticated ranges and pin playback revisions.

Stream fragmented MP4/MOV artwork with header-authenticated byte ranges. Normalize timestamp offsets and repeated initialization sections, preserve looping after buffer eviction, and reduce startup downloads for large files.

Start MP4/MOV artwork playback using header-authenticated byte ranges and Media Source Extensions. Bound playback buffering and preserve static and full-download compatibility fallbacks. No API keys in playback URLs.
